artifacts.summary: Report 03's naming-rule soundness toolkit ported into the library: L+ truth invariance under two-way bounded morphisms, Gabbay's irreflexivity rule and the clock rule, all sorry-free with no new axiom; the Auxiliary-Atoms expansion did not port and its obstruction is located.

completion_data.completion_summary: Landed three of the dispatch's four deliverables sorry-free with no new axiom: HistMorphism.plus_invariance (L+ truth invariance along any history-lifting morphism) with TwoWayBounded and TwoWayBounded.exists_histMorphism_of_isZTime in FormalSystem/Semantics/HistoryMorphism.lean, and clock_irr_sound plus irr_sound in the new FormalSystem/Metalogic/NamingRules.lean. The fourth, aa_expand, did not port: the obstruction is TaskFrame.Saturation on the unravelled carrier, which none of the tree's three discharge routes reaches, and it is recorded with evidence in the module's own docstring and the plan's Reasoned Exclusions table. Ten measured axiom profiles are pinned by C14 and ten theorem-index rows added.
